This is the furniture store. All of the items on sale have been carefully restored,
and they all look tasteful and well-loved.

1.EN:
You can sometimes find antiques in this store.
All of the items here are restored beautifully.
This place is truly a best-kept secret.

2.EN:
Don't you think we should acquire more dignified furniture
to decorate our Elysium with as well?

3.EN: "Ah, I get it. Sounds like window shopping will be pretty interesting."

4.EN:
I heard about what happened at the shrine. Wasn't that a huge mess!
Thankfully, plenty of regulars come to us for repairs and stuff,
so I wasn't that badly affected.

5.EN: No customers? I bet it's because of the heat!

6.EN:
Do you mind checking in on the other shops too?
Don't forget the shrine too, now!

7.EN: Good morning! What business do you have this early in the morning?

8.EN: "I think there's something wrong with my bath."

9.EN: That's no good! Mind if I go take a look at it right now?

10.EN: Wow, there's so much cute furniture here!

11.EN:
I'm the kind of girl who spends hooours redecorating in Animal Street,
so I love looking at furniture and stuff!

12.EN: Lately, I've been really invested in recreating Fuwa Fuwa's interior in-game!

13.EN:
"You have a good eye for design, after all.
Maybe I should ask you when we redecorate in real life too."

14.EN: Definitely! You can count on me!
